name: CI

on:
  merge_group:
  pull_request:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 3 * * tue"
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  check-up-to-dateness:
    outputs:
      is-up-to-date: ${{ steps.main.outputs.is-up-to-date }}

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - id: main
        uses: trailofbits/check-up-to-dateness@v2

  test:
    needs: [check-up-to-dateness]

    if: needs.check-up-to-dateness.outputs.is-up-to-date != 'true'

    strategy:
      fail-fast: ${{ github.event_name == 'merge_group' }}
      matrix:
        environment: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
        test: [end_to_end_0, end_to_end_1, trycmd, other]
        include:
          - environment: ubuntu-latest
            test: ci

    runs-on: ${{ matrix.environment }}

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - uses: ./.github/actions/ci
        env:
          TESTS: ${{ matrix.test }}

  all-checks:
    needs: [test]

    # smoelius: From "Defining prerequisite jobs"
    # (https://docs.github.com/en/actions/using-jobs/using-jobs-in-a-workflow#defining-prerequisite-jobs):
    # > If you would like a job to run even if a job it is dependent on did not succeed, use the
    # > `always()` conditional expression in `jobs.<job_id>.if`.
    if: ${{ always() }}

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Check results
        if: ${{ contains(needs.*.result, 'failure') || contains(needs.*.result, 'cancelled') }}
        run: exit 1

name: Update end-to-end tests

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 3 * * thu"
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: update-end-to-end-tests-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  update:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Update end-to-end tests
        run: |
          scripts/update_end_to_end_tests.sh
          scripts/update_go_end_to_end_tests.sh
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - uses: ./.github/actions/ci
        env:
          TESTS: end_to_end_0 end_to_end_1
          BLESS: "1"

      - name: Require that a snapshot changed
        id: snapshot
        run: |
          set +e
          git diff --quiet -- '*.stdout'
          status=$?
          set -e
          if [ "$status" -eq 1 ]; then
            echo "changed=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          elif [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
            exit "$status"
          fi

      # smoelius: After blessing the new output, verify that all tests pass. Note that this only
      # runs on `ubuntu-latest`, so it is not as thorough as running the CI workflow.
      - uses: ./.github/actions/ci
        if: steps.snapshot.outputs.changed == 'true'
        env:
          TESTS: end_to_end_0 end_to_end_1 trycmd other ci

      - name: Create pull request
        if: steps.snapshot.outputs.changed == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v8
        with:
          title: "Update end-to-end tests"
          commit-message: "Update end-to-end tests"
          branch-suffix: random

name: Update testing tool versions

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 3 * * wed"
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: update-testing-tool-versions-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  update:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Update testing tool versions
        run: scripts/update_testing_tool_versions.sh
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Require that a version changed
        id: snapshot
        run: |
          set +e
          git diff --exit-code -- .github/actions/install-testing-tools/versions.json
          status=$?
          set -e
          if [ "$status" -eq 1 ]; then
            echo "changed=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          elif [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
            exit "$status"
          fi

      # smoelius: Verify that all tests pass. Note that this runs only on `ubuntu-latest`, so it is
      # not as thorough as running the CI workflow.
      - uses: ./.github/actions/ci
        env:
          TESTS: end_to_end_0 end_to_end_1 trycmd other ci

      - name: Create pull request
        if: steps.snapshot.outputs.changed == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v8
        with:
          title: "Update testing tool versions"
          commit-message: "Update testing tool versions"
          branch-suffix: random

name: CI
description: Set up environment, build, and run tests

runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Set up environment
      run: echo 'CARGO_TERM_COLOR=always' >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      shell: bash

    - uses: actions/cache@v6
      with:
        path: |
          ~/.avm
          ~/.cargo/bin/
          ~/.cargo/registry/index/
          ~/.cargo/registry/cache/
          ~/.cargo/git/db/
          ~/.dylint_drivers/
          ~/.rustup/toolchains/
          target/dylint/
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}

    - uses: taiki-e/install-action@v2.87.29
      with:
        tool: cargo-hack, cargo-udeps

    - name: Rustup
      run: rustup update
      shell: bash

    - name: Install CI tools
      if: ${{ contains(env.TESTS, 'ci') }}
      run: |
        rustup +nightly component add clippy rustfmt
        cargo install cargo-dylint --git=https://github.com/trailofbits/dylint --no-default-features --features=cargo-cli || true
        cargo install dylint-link              || true
        cargo install cargo-license            || true
        cargo install cargo-sort               || true
        cargo install cargo-supply-chain       || true
        cargo install cargo-unmaintained       || true
      shell: bash

    - name: Install testing tools
      if: ${{ env.TESTS != 'ci' }}
      uses: ./.github/actions/install-testing-tools

    - name: Install sqlite3 on Ubuntu
      if: ${{ runner.os == 'Linux' }}
      run: |
        sudo apt update
        sudo apt install libsqlite3-dev
      shell: bash

    - name: Free up space on Ubuntu
      if: ${{ runner.os == 'Linux' }}
      run: |
        # https://github.com/actions/runner-images/issues/2606#issuecomment-772683150
        sudo rm -rf /usr/local/lib/android
        sudo rm -rf /usr/share/dotnet
        sudo rm -rf /usr/share/swift
      shell: bash

    - name: Install PostgreSQL client libraries on macOS
      if: ${{ runner.os == 'macOS' }}
      run: |
        brew install libpq
        echo "LIBRARY_PATH=$(brew --prefix libpq)/lib:$LIBRARY_PATH" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      shell: bash

    - name: Disable incremental compilation on Windows
      if: ${{ runner.os == 'Windows' }}
      run: echo 'CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0' >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      shell: bash

    - name: Enable debug logging
      if: ${{ runner.debug == 1 }}
      run: echo 'RUST_LOG=debug' >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      shell: bash

    - name: Build
      run: |
        for TEST in $TESTS; do
          if [[ "$TEST" != 'other' ]]; then
            $CARGO_TEST -p necessist --test "$TEST"
          else
            $CARGO_TEST -p necessist --test general
            $CARGO_TEST -p necessist-backends
            $CARGO_TEST -p necessist-core
            $CARGO_TEST -p testing
          fi
        done
      shell: bash
      env:
        CARGO_TEST: cargo test --no-run

    - name: Test
      run: |
        for TEST in $TESTS; do
          if [[ "$TEST" != 'other' ]]; then
            cargo test -p necessist --test "$TEST" -- --nocapture
          else
            cargo test -p necessist --test general
            cargo test -p necessist-backends
            cargo test -p necessist-core
            cargo test -p testing
          fi
        done
      shell: bash

[package]
name = "testing"
version = "4.1.0"
edition = "2024"
license = "AGPL-3.0"
publish = false

[dependencies]
dunce = "1.0"
regex = "1.13"
tempfile = "3.27"

[lints]
workspace = true

name: Install testing tools
description: Install tools needed for Necessist tests

runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Read versions.json
      run: |
        cat .github/actions/install-testing-tools/versions.json |
        jq -c '.[]' |
        while read X; do
          NAME="$(echo "$X" | jq -r '.name')"
          VERSION="$(echo "$X" | jq -r '.version')"
          echo "$NAME"_VERSION="$VERSION" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
        done
      shell: bash

    # smoelius: https://docs.solana.com/cli/install-solana-cli-tools
    - name: Install Agave
      if: ${{ runner.os != 'Windows' }}
      run: |
        sh -c "$(curl -sSfL https://release.anza.xyz/v$AGAVE_VERSION/install)"
        echo "$HOME/.local/share/solana/install/active_release/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
      shell: bash

    - name: Install Anchor prerequisites on Ubuntu
      if: ${{ runner.os == 'Linux' }}
      run: |
        sudo apt update
        sudo apt install libudev-dev
      shell: bash

    # smoelius: https://www.anchor-lang.com/docs/installation
    - name: Install Anchor
      if: ${{ runner.os != 'Windows' }}
      run: |
        mkdir -p ~/.config/solana
        cp backends/src/anchor/rfc8032_test_vector.json ~/.config/solana/id.json
        if [[ "$(anchor --version)" != "anchor-cli $ANCHOR_VERSION" ]]; then
          cargo install --git https://github.com/coral-xyz/anchor --tag v"$ANCHOR_VERSION" anchor-cli --force
        fi
      shell: bash

    - name: Install Foundry
      uses: foundry-rs/foundry-toolchain@v1
      with:
        version: ${{ env.FOUNDRY_VERSION }}

    - name: Install Go
      uses: actions/setup-go@v7
      with:
        go-version: "^${{ env.GO_VERSION }}"
        cache: false

    - name: Install PHP on Ubuntu
      if: ${{ runner.os == 'Linux' }}
      run: |
        sudo apt update
        sudo apt install php-cli php-xml composer
      shell: bash

    - name: Install PHP on macOS
      if: ${{ runner.os == 'macOS' }}
      run: brew install php composer
      shell: bash

    - name: Install pytest
      run: |
        if python --version 2>&1 | grep -q '^Python 3\.'; then
          PYTHON=python
        elif python3 --version 2>&1 | grep -q '^Python 3\.'; then
          PYTHON=python3
        else
          echo 'Failed to find Python 3 interpreter (`python` or `python3`)' >&2
          exit 1
        fi
        "$PYTHON" -m pip install pytest
      shell: bash

    # smoelius: The Chainlink Foundry test requires `node` and `pnpm`.
    - name: Install Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v7

    - name: Install Yarn
      if: ${{ runner.os == 'Windows' }}
      run: npm install --global yarn
      shell: bash

    - name: Install pnpm
      run: npm install --global pnpm
      shell: bash

    - name: Install Setuptools
      if: ${{ runner.os == 'macOS' }}
      run: pip install setuptools
      shell: bash
